title: Good and not so good
text: Good and not so good. Love a good egg poaching pan.  This one is just ok.  Its nice looking with 4 egg cups that fits nicely inside with a clear lid.  The eggs cook nicely.  The problem with this pan is the that the handle gets hot so there seems to be a heat distribution problem.  I don't like hot handles.
